text: Under binary validation with no functional citation mechanism there is no compounding effect: a foundational contribution becomes invisible after its own validation, and its author's reputation does not grow as others build on the work.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Evolution of Domain-Specific Reputation Systems From Binary Validation to Citation-Weighted Knowledge Attribution (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6192998
